workflows.display_name: Concept Search and Instance Retrieval Workflow
workflows.description: Canonical reusable workflow for grounded profile retrieval about an explicit Vontology concept ID, resolved concept, or authenticated first-person concept.
workflows.content: Resolve the focal concept, keep every required retrieval anchored to that same concept ID, retrieve direct concept metadata, text relations, and relation evidence, and answer only from the represented evidence for that focal concept.

input_mappings.description: Pass through the user's concept-profile request.

llm_policy.response_contract_text: Answer the user directly from grounded represented evidence for the focal concept. If the prompt contains an explicit #V# concept ID, every required retrieval call must use that exact ID as concept_id. Do not substitute the authenticated user concept for an explicit third-party concept. Retrieve fetch_concept, get_text_relations_summary, and find_relations_with_argument evidence for the same focal concept before answering. If grounded evidence is insufficient, say that clearly instead of guessing or using evidence for another concept. When using relation hits, map the related concept by argument direction: if the call used `argument_index` `subject`, use `target_concept_id`; if `object`, use `source_concept_id`; if `any`, use `target_concept_id` when present otherwise `source_concept_id`. Whenever relation-grounded items are reported, emit each item as a Markdown bullet containing the resolved `#V#...` concept ID. Never present relation output as prose like `subject --predicate--> object`. If a relation hit has no usable `#V#` concept ID, omit that item and mention explicitly that the result had no usable `#V#` concept ID.
